name: photo_memory
objective: Guard the pure functions behind the race-photo feature: metadata extraction from free-form Chinese text, and photo search precision.

extraction_accuracy.description: Fraction of extraction cases where every field the case declares matches exactly. Covers event name, race date and finish time.

search_exact_match.description: Fraction of search cases where the returned set of events equals the expected set. This now guards the FALLBACK path only: live search asks the model to pick group ids directly. Kept because the fallback is what runs whenever the model is unavailable.

merge_correctness.description: Fraction of merge cases where the resulting groups, the target's photo count, and the total photo count across all groups all match. Total count is the key invariant: merging deletes a whole group, so losing a photo must fail loudly.

intent_guard_accuracy.description: Fraction of intent-sanitization cases where the over-reach guards produce the expected action and ids. The model can emit anything; this layer is what stops it from merging groups it was not told to merge or citing photo ids that do not exist.

constraints: Pure functions only: no embedding, no LLM, no network. This suite runs anywhere and never needs to be skipped.
Search runs against fixtures in the dataset, not the live photos.json, so results stay reproducible as the user stores more photos.
Extraction cases only assert the fields they declare, so a case about finish time does not need to also pin down the event name.
Thresholds are 1.0 because these are deterministic pure functions, not a ranking system: any failure is a real defect, not noise.
Merge cases assert total photo count is unchanged, not just that the groups look right: the whole point of the guard is that a merge must never lose a photo.
Intent-guard cases feed hand-built model output straight into _sanitize, so they need no LLM: the point is to test the guard, not the model.

baseline.note: 建立时同时锁住三个刚修复的缺陷：成绩抽取认不出「成绩是4:30:48」和中文数字、赛事名把「帮我存一下」吞进去、搜索用纯 OR 匹配导致任何含「马拉松」的查询返回全部照片。
